alternative_explanations: The finite hand-written truth-table library and exhaustive clean single-node interventions may make exact recovery deterministic rather than demonstrate general learned representation.
Deterministic query selection is adversarial only to registered random, majority and parity controls; an unregistered nonlinear heuristic may remain.
A trained dense nonlinear predictor or modern unknown-intervention causal learner could match the capability under a fairer representation budget.
confounds: The benchmark remains a visible synthetic DAG with stable discrete tokens, complete clean intervention coverage and known binary variables.
K scales irrelevant roots and raw input length together, so full K slope measures the declared observation boundary rather than persistent-model access alone.
falsification_criteria: Reduce HYP-0008 and end tuning of this apparatus if any learned seed or cell falls below 0.95 accuracy/OOD, target mapping, active structure or gate accuracy, if relative seed CV exceeds 0.10, or if the per-seed gap over the strongest registered simple shortcut is below 0.25.

Treat the screen as integrity-inconclusive if any cell is not exactly label-balanced, independent random or parity exceeds 5/12 in a cell, majority differs from 0.5, any candidate fails, or protected integrity changes.

outcome_policy.negative: If exact recovery or seed stability fails under the unchanged cohort, reduce HYP-0008 materially, end tuning of this implementation and pivot to a different architecture family.
outcome_policy.null: If exact recovery replicates but a control, Pareto or cost gate fails, keep HYP-0008 testing without promotion and choose the cheapest new-task-family discriminator.
outcome_policy.positive: Keep the mechanism as a replicated narrow causal-transfer result and consider HYP-0008 promising only under the registered Pareto and prior-art conditions; next test must transfer beyond exhaustive clean binary truth-table worlds rather than tune this cohort.

predicted_outcome: Every cell is exactly label-balanced. In every seed, independent random and parity score at most 5/12 in every cell, majority scores exactly 0.5, and raw episode prediction averages at most 0.75. Learned factorized and both oracle controls reach at least 0.95 accuracy/OOD, mapping, structure and gate accuracy in every cell, with learned per-seed accuracy at least 0.95 and relative seed CV at most 0.10. Learned beats the strongest registered simple shortcut by at least 0.25 in every seed. Full query K slope exceeds 0.35 in every seed because perception grows with unordered roots, while local ops and visited nodes are K-invariant at fixed seed and D.
promotion_criteria: Screen may justify promising only if all three seeds pass every capability and control gate, learned factorization is on the accuracy-gated Pareto frontier among non-oracle controls, prior-art records SRC-0018 through SRC-0021 are acknowledged, and full input, fit, state and oracle advantages remain disclosed; screen cannot promote the family.
research_question: Does the corrected latent causal factorization replicate across three opaque-code and mixed-gate worlds while preserving exact recovery, separation from registered shortcuts, local K-invariance, and explicit full-input K cost?
title: Multi-seed shortcut-resistant latent causal transfer screen
